title: The ‘Vulnpocalypse’ is coming for the internet’s aging code, says Wiz’s CTO
hook_text: Seventy percent of websites run on aging code.
script:
Seventy percent of websites run on aging code that faces a massive crisis.
Cloud security company Wiz warns that the internet is barreling toward what it calls a vulnpocalypse.
Last week, two critical bugs in PHP left organizations scrambling to patch their systems.
Organizations took affected web properties entirely offline until the vulnerabilities were fixed.
TechCrunch notes that cleanup efforts for these aging open source systems are far from over.
How many legacy systems in your stack are still waiting for a critical security patch?
